title: Run a shell command
summary: Runs a bash command in a persistent session. Off unless the operator enables the shell.
name: shell_exec
description: The command is scanned. Hard blocks never run. Risky commands wait for a button. The shell keeps its folder and variables between calls. Output is redacted.

parameters.name: session
parameters.meaning: Name of a persistent shell session.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.meaning: Seconds to wait for output before returning.

parameters.name: cwd
parameters.meaning: Starting folder, inside the shell workspace.

parameters.name: interactive
parameters.meaning: Keep the process open so shell_send can type into it.

returns: Output so far, and whether the command is still running.
approval_rule: Depends on SHELL_APPROVAL. Default risky: MEDIUM and HIGH need a button. HARD BLOCK commands never run.
side_effects: Runs as the bot's OS user
Can change files, use the network and start processes.

failure_modes.what_the_agent_sees: A message that the shell is disabled by the operator

title: View shell output
summary: Shows new output of a shell session.
name: shell_view
description: Shows new output of a shell session.

parameters.name: session
parameters.meaning: Name of a persistent shell session.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.meaning: Seconds to wait for output before returning.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.meaning: How many output lines to show.

parameters.name: tail
parameters.meaning: Show the last lines instead of the first.

title: Type into a shell program
summary: Sends text to an interactive program.
name: shell_send
description: Only works for sessions started with interactive true. Goes through the same scan.

parameters.name: session
parameters.meaning: Name of a persistent shell session.

approval_rule: Text is scanned like a command.
side_effects: Sends input to a running process.

title: Stop a shell command
summary: Interrupts, terminates, kills or closes a session.
name: shell_kill
description: Interrupts, terminates, kills or closes a session.

parameters.name: session
parameters.meaning: Name of a persistent shell session.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.meaning: How hard to stop the process.
parameters.limits: One of: interrupt, terminate, kill, close.

title: Shell facts
summary: Shows workspace folder, free disk, sessions and tools.
name: shell_info
description: Shows workspace folder, free disk, sessions and tools.
